title: Chapter 237: Bright Griffin Knight
content:
Chapter 237: Bright Griffin Knight

One thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, this is an unprecedented big deal!

The five-star Zerg destroyers have greatly improved in terms of range, firing speed, attack power and attack range, especially with the strength star level of the alien army soldiers.

This gap is fatal!

The one-star strength of the alien army soldiers, basically can not withstand the attack of the five-star Zerg destroyers, all of them are killed in one blow!

Under such an attack, the number of deaths in the center of the explosion of the two-star strength alien army soldiers exceeded half, and the remaining wounded were all seriously injured and dying, and had no combat power.

With such a fierce firepower, Wu Qing was relatively satisfied, but the number was still a little less.

Wu Qing first commanded a thousand five-star Zerg destroyers to attack the alien heavy cavalry troops that were charging forward and restrained by the trapping nets in large numbers, and launched three rounds of covering attacks.

"Boom boom boom...!"

These three rounds of powerful attacks were like battlefield sweepers, sweeping away nearly half of the two-star alien heavy cavalry whose various defenses had been exhausted or were about to be exhausted!

The alien army suffered too much loss this time!

The powerful heavy cavalry unit, which originally had nearly 200,000 troops, now has only about 60,000 or 70,000 troops, and they are basically the remnants of the magic blessing and energy defense that are about to be exhausted!

"The alien heavy cavalry unit is finished!"

"Haha, I didn't expect them to have this day!"

"This Zerg army is too powerful! It can be upgraded at any time!"

"Others are not strong enough to upgrade reluctantly! The Zerg is not strong enough to upgrade at any time!"

"All are five-star ultra-long-range attack arms! This firepower is too powerful! How can ordinary armies stop it!"

"..."

Staring at the Zerg army and the surrounding friendly forces, he was once again shocked by the performance of the Zerg army!

Of the original 50,000 Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army, only 100 had the strength of four stars, and only 900 had the strength of three stars.

Even if the remaining Zerg destroyers were upgraded to two stars, the overall strength had been greatly improved, but when facing an army with strong defensive capabilities like the alien army, the killing efficiency was still too low.

Now there are a thousand five-star Zerg destroyers at once, and the firepower of the Zerg army's ultra-long-range attack has made a qualitative leap.

After three rounds of attacks by a thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, Wu Qing no longer paid attention to the remaining 60,000 or 70,000 remnants of the alien heavy cavalry. He ordered the five-star Zerg destroyers to turn their target to the infantry phalanx with more troops behind the alien heavy cavalry.

The first infantry phalanx of the alien army followed closely behind the heavy cavalry. Under the continuous attack of the Zerg destroyers, it stubbornly advanced and had already approached the heavy cavalry phalanx.

If this infantry phalanx moves forward a distance, the crossbowmen in the phalanx can launch an attack.

The target of attack of one thousand five-star Zerg destroyers turned to this infantry phalanx.

Suddenly, one thousand extremely powerful liquid fireball shells evenly fell on the severely reduced infantry phalanx of the alien race, just like a thousand erasers wiping on a painting, and a large area of blank area appeared in the huge infantry phalanx.

The attack of the five-star Zerg destroyers has exceeded the defense limit of the infantry of the alien army. As long as the infantry affected, no matter what kind of soldiers, basically disappeared directly.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Along with tens of thousands of liquid fireball shells, another thousand powerful shells fell, and the resulting aggregate attack effect almost crippled the entire infantry phalanx of the alien race!

Such firepower output not only shocked all parties in the local camp, but also made many high-level officials of the alien army numb.

Since the Tianwai people participated in this battlefield, they have never encountered such a speed of loss of troops.

"Which big tribe has personally come to the battlefield?"

"You go on stage! See if you can save the situation!"

"If it doesn't work, withdraw!"

"You should be careful of that weird attack, pay attention to safety!"

The human knight with gorgeous full armor has been sitting steadily on the tall warhorse. He was originally very calm, but now he also spoke.

Behind him, there are one hundred very special human archers. They are wearing light and lightweight armor, equipped with a short sword and a milky white bow. This bow is very conspicuous.

The aura of these people is very powerful, hidden but not released, and it seems to contain an extremely sharp edge.

The leader among them respectfully received the order from the human knight, and then led the team to leave a certain distance. With a whistle, one hundred huge light griffins flew down from the sky.

Before the light griffins landed completely, they jumped up and jumped onto the back of the giant light griffins.

The giant light griffin soared into the sky and flew towards the direction of the Zerg army.

There were four-star Zerg hosts who had been keeping a close eye on the movements of the alien army, and this scene did not escape their eyes.

"The strength of these one hundred alien archers is extremely strong!"

The Queen passed this information to Wu Qing, and Wu Qing immediately upgraded the remaining ninety Zerg queens to five stars on the spot.

Then choose to upgrade one hundred Zerg dragons and one hundred Zerg hydralisks to increase their strength to five stars.

At this point, the system's originally sufficient resources have become scarce again.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

Fortunately, we are still on the battlefield, and we have a lot of income every moment.

As soon as the Zerg army was upgraded, the 100 Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe flew into the group of Light Griffins.

The Light Griffins above the Alien Tribe army began to accelerate and flew towards the Zerg army.

The 100 Light Griffin Knights were hidden in the group of Light Griffins.

The group of Light Griffins of the Alien Tribe army bypassed the front with the strongest defense capability, flew over the other local camps, and attacked the right side of the Zerg army square.

The Zerg in the Zerg army square cooperated very well. They were originally one body, and it was very quick and convenient to mobilize. A large number of two-star Zerg Hydralisks were transferred to the right side of the Zerg army square.

The 100 Zerg Hydralisks that had just been upgraded to five stars were among them.

Wu Qing ordered the Zerg Dragons to stay where they were, and did not take the initiative to fight. He stayed above the Zerg army square, waiting for the arrival of the alien human flying troops.

The target of the alien human army must be the Zerg Destroyer, which is the most threatening. As long as the Zerg army protects the Zerg Destroyer, it will be victorious.

The anti-air range of the Zerg Hydralisk is much longer than the long-range attack range of the flying troops.

When the group of light griffins of the alien human army flew into the air defense range of the Zerg Hydralisk, the high-star Zerg Hydralisk began to fire armor-piercing spikes and launched an attack.

The armor-piercing spikes fired by the three-star, four-star, and five-star Zerg Hydralisks could not be resisted by the group of light griffins, whose average strength was less than two stars, and they were shot down and killed and disappeared.

The light griffins flew very fast and suffered certain losses. They flew into the attack range of a large number of two-star Zerg Hydralisks at once.

Dense armor-piercing spikes whizzed into the sky. The unavoidable group of light griffins, shining with light energy, charged forward at high speed despite the fierce anti-aircraft fire!

The shot-down light griffins fell like rain, and continued to turn into light and disappear in mid-air.

The light griffins rushed close to the Zerg army's square formation at the cost of heavy losses, and a large number of light attribute energy balls were ejected towards the Zerg army square formation below.

They also entered the attack range of the Zerg dragon group. Under the leadership of the five-star Zerg dragon, a large number of biological bombs flew towards the light griffin group!

"Boom...!"

Various explosions sounded, and a fierce melee began.

The light griffins of the alien human army rushed towards the Zerg army square formation without caring about casualties. The large number of light attribute energy balls they ejected fell into the Zerg army square formation.

The Zerg Hydralisks in the Zerg Army's square began to suffer casualties, but the Light Griffins, which were under the double attack of the Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Dragons from the ground and air, suffered even more severe losses and their numbers dropped sharply!

The purpose of the alien light griffins' attack regardless of casualties was to cover the 100 powerful light griffin knights' attack on the Zerg destroyers.

Wu Qing also knew the purpose of the alien army, but the 100 light griffin knights were well hidden in the light griffins, and the Zerg Queen could not find an opportunity to attack.

If the target cannot be seen or sensed, the Zerg Queen cannot attack.

The 100 light griffin knights not only blocked the line of sight with other light griffins, but also had magical magic to shield others' perception.

The strength of the four-star Zerg host was still a little weak. They could vaguely sense their existence, but could not guide the Zerg Queen to attack effectively.

After discovering this situation, it was too late to upgrade the Zerg host.

Faced with such a situation, the Zerg army could only bear a little loss, and then make it back from the alien army.

When the aliens' light griffin group lost more than half, they finally rushed to the right distance, and a hundred huge light griffins suddenly rushed out!

The light attribute energy on their bodies is extremely dazzling, like small suns hanging in the sky, and all attacks on them have no effect!

Milky white light arrows shot out from their bodies, as fast as lightning, shooting at the huge five-star Zerg destroyer in the center of the Zerg army's square!

The one hundred powerful light griffin knights, each of them shot three times in a row, a total of nine hundred light arrows containing huge light attribute purification energy, leaping across space, accurately shooting through the Zerg puppies blocking the five-star Zerg destroyers, and shooting the nine hundred five-star Zerg destroyers that were attacking!
